题目 › usaco-1454

Maximize Minimum Difference

USACO 2024 December · 铂金组 · 2024-12 · L4 顶尖 · C++17 · 时限 4 秒 · 测试点等分

查看原题跳到结果

题面

来源：USACO 官网。模型收到的是同一份题面的文字。

**Note: The time limit for this problem is 4s, twice the default.**

Moo! You are given an integer $N$ ($2\le N\le 2000$). Consider all permutations $p=[p_0,p_1,\dots, p_{N-1}]$ of $[0,1,2\dots, N-1]$. Let $f(p)=\min_{i=0}^{N-2}|p_i-p_{i+1}|$ denote the minimum absolute difference between any two consecutive elements of $p$. and let $S$ denote the set of all $p$ that achieve the maximum possible value of $f(p)$.

You are additionally given $K$ ($0\le K\le N$) constraints of the form $p_i=j$ ($0\le i,j<N$). Count the number of permutations in $S$ satisfying all constraints, modulo $10^9+7$.

INPUT FORMAT (input arrives from the terminal / stdin):

The first line contains $T$ ($1\le TN\le 2\cdot 10^4$) and $N$, meaning that you will need to solve $T$ independent test cases, each specified by a different set of constraints.

Each test case starts with $K$, followed by $K$ lines each containing $i$ and $j$. It is guaranteed that

  • The same $i$ does not appear more than once within the same test case.
  • The same $j$ does not appear more than once within the same test case.

OUTPUT FORMAT (print output to the terminal / stdout):

For each test case, the answer modulo $10^9+7$ on a separate line.

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

static const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;

int N, M;
vector<long long> factv, invfactv, pow2v;
vector<int> wantPos, wantVal;

long long modpow(long long a, long long e) {
    long long r = 1;
    while (e) {
        if (e & 1) r = r * a % MOD;
        a = a * a % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return r;
}

long long comb(int n, int k) {
    if (k < 0 || k > n || n < 0) return 0;
    return factv[n] * invfactv[k] % MOD * invfactv[n - k] % MOD;
}

bool fixedOK(int v, int pos) {
    if (pos < 0 || pos >= N) return false;
    if (wantVal[v] != -1 && wantVal[v] != pos) return false;
    if (wantPos[pos] != -1 && wantPos[pos] != v) return false;
    return true;
}

// type 0: [q, M+q], type 1: [M+q, q].
bool tokenOK(int q, int type, int start) {
    if (type == 0) {
        return fixedOK(q, start) && fixedOK(M + q, start + 1);
    } else {
        return fixedOK(M + q, start) && fixedOK(q, start + 1);
    }
}

struct Event {
    int t, q;
};

struct Layout {
    int kind;       // 0: generic two-sided layout, 1: form with two F-blocks sides
    int leftBase;
    int rightEnd;
    int rightBase;
    int selectedType;
    int unselectedType;
};

int placementStart(const Layout& lay, bool selected, int c, int t) {
    if (lay.kind == 0) {
        if (selected) return lay.leftBase + 2 * c;
        return lay.rightEnd - 2 * (t - c + 1);
    } else {
        if (selected) return 2 * c;
        return lay.rightBase + 2 * (t - c);
    }
}

bool getCandidate(const Layout& lay, bool selected, int q, int t, int& cOut) {
    int type = selected ? lay.selectedType : lay.unselectedType;
    int start = -1;

    if (wantVal[q] != -1) {
        int offset = (type == 0 ? 0 : 1);
        start = wantVal[q] - offset;
    } else if (wantVal[M + q] != -1) {
        int offset = (type == 0 ? 1 : 0);
        start = wantVal[M + q] - offset;
    } else {
        return false;
    }

    int c = -1;
    if (lay.kind == 0) {
        if (selected) {
            int diff = start - lay.leftBase;
            if (diff < 0 || (diff & 1)) return false;
            c = diff / 2;
        } else {
            int diff = lay.rightEnd - start;
            if (diff <= 0 || (diff & 1)) return false;
            c = t + 1 - diff / 2;
        }
    } else {
        if (selected) {
            if (start < 0 || (start & 1)) return false;
            c = start / 2;
        } else {
            int diff = start - lay.rightBase;
            if (diff < 0 || (diff & 1)) return false;
            c = t - diff / 2;
        }
    }

    if (c < 0 || c > t) return false;
    int actualStart = placementStart(lay, selected, c, t);
    if (actualStart != start) return false;
    if (!tokenOK(q, type, start)) return false;

    cOut = c;
    return true;
}

long long countAssignments(int h, const vector<Event>& events,
                           int totalRequired, const Layout& lay) {
    if (totalRequired > h) return 0;

    vector<pair<int, long long>> states;
    states.push_back({0, 1});
    int processed = 0;

    for (const Event& ev : events) {
        int gap = ev.t - processed;
        vector<pair<int, long long>> nextStates;

        for (int sel = 0; sel <= 1; ++sel) {
            int c;
            if (!getCandidate(lay, sel, ev.q, ev.t, c)) continue;

            long long ways = 0;
            for (auto [oldC, oldWays] : states) {
                ways = (ways + oldWays * comb(gap, c - oldC)) % MOD;
            }
            if (!ways) continue;

            int newC = c + sel;
            bool merged = false;
            for (auto& entry : nextStates) {
                if (entry.first == newC) {
                    entry.second = (entry.second + ways) % MOD;
                    merged = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!merged) nextStates.push_back({newC, ways});
        }

        if (nextStates.empty()) return 0;
        states.swap(nextStates);
        processed = ev.t + 1;
    }

    int remaining = h - processed;
    long long answer = 0;

    if (totalRequired == -1) {
        for (auto [c, ways] : states) {
            answer = (answer + ways * pow2v[remaining]) % MOD;
        }
    } else {
        for (auto [c, ways] : states) {
            answer = (answer + ways * comb(remaining, totalRequired - c)) % MOD;
        }
    }
    return answer;
}

vector<Event> makeEvents(int lo, int hi, int mode) {
    vector<Event> events;
    if (lo > hi) return events;

    if (mode == 0) {
        for (int q = hi; q >= lo; --q) {
            if (wantVal[q] != -1 || wantVal[M + q] != -1) {
                events.push_back({hi - q, q});
            }
        }
    } else {
        for (int q = lo; q <= hi; ++q) {
            if (wantVal[q] != -1 || wantVal[M + q] != -1) {
                events.push_back({q - lo, q});
            }
        }
    }
    return events;
}

// F/R two-sided layout with one variable-position middle token.
long long genericCount(int lo, int hi, int leftBase, int rightEnd,
                       int middleValue, int mode) {
    int h = max(0, hi - lo + 1);
    vector<Event> events = makeEvents(lo, hi, mode);

    int totalRequired = -1;
    if (wantVal[middleValue] != -1) {
        int pos = wantVal[middleValue];
        int diff = pos - leftBase;
        if (diff < 0 || (diff & 1)) return 0;
        totalRequired = diff / 2;
        if (totalRequired < 0 || totalRequired > h) return 0;
        if (!fixedOK(middleValue, pos)) return 0;
    }

    Layout lay;
    lay.kind = 0;
    lay.leftBase = leftBase;
    lay.rightEnd = rightEnd;
    lay.rightBase = 0;

    if (mode == 0) {
        lay.selectedType = 0;
        lay.unselectedType = 1;
    } else {
        lay.selectedType = 1;
        lay.unselectedType = 0;
    }

    return countAssignments(h, events, totalRequired, lay);
}

long long countCanonicalOdd() {
    int h = M - 1;
    long long answer = 0;

    // [M,0], R(Q) increasing, N-1, F(S) decreasing.
    if (fixedOK(M, 0) && fixedOK(0, 1)) {
        answer += genericCount(1, M - 1, 2, N, N - 1, 1);
    }

    // F(P) decreasing, [0,M,N-1], F(S) decreasing.
    vector<Event> middleEvents = makeEvents(1, M - 1, 0);
    for (int p = 0; p <= h; ++p) {
        int a = 2 * p;
        if (!fixedOK(0, a) || !fixedOK(M, a + 1) ||
            !fixedOK(N - 1, a + 2)) {
            continue;
        }

        Layout lay;
        lay.kind = 1;
        lay.leftBase = 0;
        lay.rightEnd = 0;
        lay.rightBase = 2 * p + 3;
        lay.selectedType = 0;
        lay.unselectedType = 0;

        answer += countAssignments(h, middleEvents, p, lay);
        if (answer >= MOD) answer -= MOD;
    }

    // F(P) decreasing, 0, R(Q) increasing, [N-1,M].
    if (fixedOK(N - 1, N - 2) && fixedOK(M, N - 1)) {
        answer += genericCount(1, M - 1, 0, N - 2, 0, 0);
    }
    answer %= MOD;

    // Defective forms, containing [N-1,M,0].
    for (int d = 1; d <= M - 1; ++d) {
        int highCount = M - 1 - d;
        int posB = 2 * highCount + 1;

        if (!fixedOK(N - 1, posB) ||
            !fixedOK(M, posB + 1) ||
            !fixedOK(0, posB + 2)) {
            continue;
        }

        long long highWays = genericCount(
            d + 1, M - 1, 0, posB, d, 0
        );
        if (!highWays) continue;

        long long lowWays = genericCount(
            1, d - 1, posB + 3, N, M + d, 1
        );

        answer = (answer + highWays * lowWays) % MOD;
    }

    return answer;
}

long long countCanonicalEven() {
    vector<int> seq;
    seq.reserve(N);
    for (int k = 0; k < M; ++k) {
        seq.push_back(M - 1 - k);
        seq.push_back(2 * M - 1 - k);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        if (wantPos[i] != -1 && wantPos[i] != seq[i]) return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

long long solveCanonical(const vector<pair<int, int>>& constraints, bool reversed) {
    wantPos.assign(N, -1);
    wantVal.assign(N, -1);

    for (auto [i, j] : constraints) {
        int pos = reversed ? N - 1 - i : i;
        wantPos[pos] = j;
        wantVal[j] = pos;
    }

    if (N % 2 == 0) return countCanonicalEven();
    return countCanonicalOdd();
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int T;
    cin >> T >> N;
    M = N / 2;

    factv.assign(N + 1, 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
        factv[i] = factv[i - 1] * i % MOD;
    }
    invfactv.assign(N + 1, 1);
    invfactv[N] = modpow(factv[N], MOD - 2);
    for (int i = N; i >= 1; --i) {
        invfactv[i - 1] = invfactv[i] * i % MOD;
    }

    pow2v.assign(N + 1, 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
        pow2v[i] = pow2v[i - 1] * 2 % MOD;
    }

    while (T--) {
        int K;
        cin >> K;
        vector<pair<int, int>> constraints(K);
        for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
            cin >> constraints[i].first >> constraints[i].second;
        }

        long long answer = solveCanonical(constraints, false);
        answer += solveCanonical(constraints, true);
        answer %= MOD;
        cout << answer << '\n';
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using int64 = long long;
static const int MOD = 1000000007;

int addmod(int a, int b) {
    int s = a + b;
    if (s >= MOD) s -= MOD;
    return s;
}

struct Option {
    int col;
    int req;
};

struct StageOptions {
    int t;
    int n;
    array<Option, 2> op;
};

struct Spec {
    array<int, 2> val;
    array<int, 2> offset;
    int base;
    int step;
    int maxReq;
};

struct Solver {
    int N, m, u;
    vector<int> valPos;

    int binom(int n, int k, const vector<int64>& fact, const vector<int64>& invfact) const {
        if (k < 0 || k > n || n < 0) return 0;
        return int(fact[n] * invfact[k] % MOD * invfact[n - k] % MOD);
    }

    int countChoices(int stages, const vector<StageOptions>& cs, int total,
                     const vector<int64>& fact, const vector<int64>& invfact,
                     const vector<int>& pow2) const {
        if (cs.empty()) {
            if (total == -1) return pow2[stages];
            return binom(stages, total, fact, invfact);
        }

        array<int64, 2> dp{}, ndp{};

        const StageOptions& first = cs.front();
        for (int i = 0; i < first.n; ++i) {
            dp[i] = binom(first.t, first.op[i].req, fact, invfact);
        }
        int prevN = first.n;
        StageOptions prev = first;

        for (int z = 1; z < (int)cs.size(); ++z) {
            const StageOptions& cur = cs[z];
            ndp = {0, 0};
            int gap = cur.t - prev.t - 1;

            for (int i = 0; i < prevN; ++i) {
                if (!dp[i]) continue;
                int before = prev.op[i].req + (prev.op[i].col == 1);
                for (int j = 0; j < cur.n; ++j) {
                    int need = cur.op[j].req - before;
                    int ways = binom(gap, need, fact, invfact);
                    ndp[j] = (ndp[j] + dp[i] * ways) % MOD;
                }
            }

            dp = ndp;
            prevN = cur.n;
            prev = cur;
        }

        int suffix = stages - 1 - prev.t;
        int64 ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < prevN; ++i) {
            if (!dp[i]) continue;
            int before = prev.op[i].req + (prev.op[i].col == 1);
            if (total == -1) {
                ans = (ans + dp[i] * pow2[suffix]) % MOD;
            } else {
                int need = total - before;
                ans = (ans + dp[i] * binom(suffix, need, fact, invfact)) % MOD;
            }
        }
        return int(ans);
    }

    bool addStage(vector<StageOptions>& cs, int t, int off,
                  const array<Spec, 2>& spec) const {
        bool constrained = false;
        for (int k = 0; k < 2; ++k) {
            if (valPos[spec[0].val[k]] != -1) constrained = true;
        }
        if (!constrained) return true;

        StageOptions so;
        so.t = t;
        so.n = 0;

        for (int col = 0; col < 2; ++col) {
            bool ok = true;
            int requirement = -1;

            for (int k = 0; k < 2 && ok; ++k) {
                int value = spec[col].val[k];
                int p = valPos[value];
                if (p == -1) continue;

                int64 local = (int64)p - off;
                int64 start = local - spec[col].offset[k];
                int64 diff = start - spec[col].base;
                int step = spec[col].step;

                if (diff % step != 0) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }

                int64 req = diff / step;
                if (req < 0 || req > spec[col].maxReq) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }

                if (requirement != -1 && requirement != req) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }
                requirement = int(req);
            }

            if (ok) {
                so.op[so.n++] = {col, requirement};
            }
        }

        if (so.n == 0) return false;
        cs.push_back(so);
        return true;
    }

    int fixedAt(int value, int position) const {
        return valPos[value] == -1 || valPos[value] == position;
    }

    int countA(int s, int off,
               const vector<int64>& fact, const vector<int64>& invfact,
               const vector<int>& pow2) const {
        int stages = s - 1;

        if (!fixedAt(0, off)) return 0;

        int total = -1;
        int markValue = m + s;
        if (valPos[markValue] != -1) {
            int local = valPos[markValue] - off;
            if (local < 1 || (local - 1) % 2 != 0) return 0;
            total = (local - 1) / 2;
            if (total < 0 || total > stages) return 0;
        }

        vector<StageOptions> cs;
        for (int r = 1; r <= stages; ++r) {
            int L = r;
            int H = m + r;

            array<Spec, 2> spec;

            // Color 0: L, pair (L_r,H_r), start = 2(s-r)+2a.
            spec[0].val = {L, H};
            spec[0].offset = {0, 1};
            spec[0].base = 2 * (s - r);
            spec[0].step = 2;
            spec[0].maxReq = r - 1;

            // Color 1: R, pair (H_r,L_r), start = 1+2a.
            spec[1].val = {H, L};
            spec[1].offset = {0, 1};
            spec[1].base = 1;
            spec[1].step = 2;
            spec[1].maxReq = r - 1;

            if (!addStage(cs, r - 1, off, spec)) return 0;
        }

        return countChoices(stages, cs, total, fact, invfact, pow2);
    }

    int countB(const vector<int64>& fact, const vector<int64>& invfact,
               const vector<int>& pow2) const {
        int stages = m - 1;

        if (!fixedAt(2 * m, 2 * m - 1)) return 0;

        int total = -1;
        if (valPos[0] != -1) {
            int local = valPos[0];
            if (local < 0 || local % 2 != 0) return 0;
            total = local / 2;
            if (total < 0 || total > stages) return 0;
        }

        vector<StageOptions> cs;
        for (int t = 0; t < stages; ++t) {
            int r = stages - t;
            int L = r;
            int H = m + r;

            array<Spec, 2> spec;

            // Color 0: R, pair (H_r,L_r), start = 2r-1+2x.
            spec[0].val = {H, L};
            spec[0].offset = {0, 1};
            spec[0].base = 2 * r - 1;
            spec[0].step = 2;
            spec[0].maxReq = stages - r;

            // Color 1: D, pair (L_r,H_r), start = 2x.
            spec[1].val = {L, H};
            spec[1].offset = {0, 1};
            spec[1].base = 0;
            spec[1].step = 2;
            spec[1].maxReq = stages - r;

            if (!addStage(cs, t, 0, spec)) return 0;
        }

        return countChoices(stages, cs, total, fact, invfact, pow2);
    }

    int countQ0(int T, const vector<int64>& fact, const vector<int64>& invfact,
                const vector<int>& pow2) const {
        if (!fixedAt(0, 2 * T)) return 0;
        if (!fixedAt(m, 2 * T + 1)) return 0;
        if (!fixedAt(2 * m, 2 * T + 2)) return 0;

        vector<StageOptions> cs;
        for (int r = 1; r <= u; ++r) {
            int L = r;
            int H = m + r;

            array<Spec, 2> spec;

            // Color 0: A, start = 2u-2r+3+2b.
            spec[0].val = {L, H};
            spec[0].offset = {0, 1};
            spec[0].base = 2 * u - 2 * r + 3;
            spec[0].step = 2;
            spec[0].maxReq = r - 1;

            // Color 1: B, start = 2(T-1)-2b.
            spec[1].val = {L, H};
            spec[1].offset = {0, 1};
            spec[1].base = 2 * T - 2;
            spec[1].step = -2;
            spec[1].maxReq = r - 1;

            if (!addStage(cs, r - 1, 0, spec)) return 0;
        }

        return countChoices(u, cs, T, fact, invfact, pow2);
    }

    int countLate(int s, const vector<int64>& fact, const vector<int64>& invfact,
                  const vector<int>& pow2) const {
        int lateStages = u - s;

        int total = -1;
        if (valPos[s] != -1) {
            int p = valPos[s];
            if (p < 0 || p % 2 != 0) return 0;
            total = p / 2;
            if (total < 0 || total > lateStages) return 0;
        }

        vector<StageOptions> cs;
        for (int t = 0; t < lateStages; ++t) {
            int r = u - t;
            int L = r;
            int H = m + r;

            array<Spec, 2> spec;

            // Color 0: A, pair (H_r,L_r).
            spec[0].val = {H, L};
            spec[0].offset = {0, 1};
            spec[0].base = 2 * r - 2 * s - 1;
            spec[0].step = 2;
            spec[0].maxReq = u - r;

            // Color 1: B, pair (L_r,H_r).
            spec[1].val = {L, H};
            spec[1].offset = {0, 1};
            spec[1].base = 0;
            spec[1].step = 2;
            spec[1].maxReq = u - r;

            if (!addStage(cs, t, 0, spec)) return 0;
        }

        return countChoices(lateStages, cs, total, fact, invfact, pow2);
    }

    int run(const vector<int64>& fact, const vector<int64>& invfact,
            const vector<int>& pow2) const {
        int64 ans = 0;

        // Center prepended, base path of type A.
        if (fixedAt(m, 0)) {
            ans += countA(m, 1, fact, invfact, pow2);
        }

        // Center appended, base path of type B.
        if (fixedAt(m, 2 * m)) {
            ans += countB(fact, invfact, pow2);
        }

        // Internal center, orientation 0,center,H_m.
        for (int T = 0; T <= u; ++T) {
            ans += countQ0(T, fact, invfact, pow2);
            if (ans >= MOD) ans -= MOD;
        }

        // Internal center, orientation H_m,center,0.
        for (int s = 1; s <= u; ++s) {
            int v = u - s;
            if (!fixedAt(2 * m, 2 * v + 1)) continue;
            if (!fixedAt(m, 2 * v + 2)) continue;

            int early = countA(s, 2 * v + 3, fact, invfact, pow2);
            if (!early) continue;
            int late = countLate(s, fact, invfact, pow2);
            ans = (ans + (int64)early * late) % MOD;
        }

        return int(ans % MOD);
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int T, N;
    cin >> T >> N;

    vector<int64> fact(N + 1), invfact(N + 1);
    vector<int> pow2(N + 1);

    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % MOD;

    auto modpow = [&](int64 a, int e) {
        int64 r = 1;
        while (e) {
            if (e & 1) r = r * a % MOD;
            a = a * a % MOD;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return r;
    };

    invfact[N] = modpow(fact[N], MOD - 2);
    for (int i = N; i >= 1; --i) invfact[i - 1] = invfact[i] * i % MOD;

    pow2[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) pow2[i] = addmod(pow2[i - 1], pow2[i - 1]);

    while (T--) {
        int K;
        cin >> K;

        vector<pair<int, int>> constraints(K);
        vector<int> valPos(N, -1);

        for (int k = 0; k < K; ++k) {
            int i, j;
            cin >> i >> j;
            constraints[k] = {i, j};
            valPos[j] = i;
        }

        if (N % 2 == 0) {
            int half = N / 2;
            vector<int> p;
            for (int k = 0; k < half; ++k) {
                p.push_back(half + k);
                p.push_back(k);
            }
            vector<int> rev = p;
            reverse(rev.begin(), rev.end());

            int answer = 0;
            for (const vector<int>* q : {&p, &rev}) {
                bool ok = true;
                for (auto [i, j] : constraints) {
                    if ((*q)[i] != j) {
                        ok = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (ok) answer = addmod(answer, 1);
            }
            cout << answer << '\n';
            continue;
        }

        Solver solver;
        solver.N = N;
        solver.m = N / 2;
        solver.u = solver.m - 1;
        solver.valPos = valPos;

        int answer = solver.run(fact, invfact, pow2);

        vector<int> reversedValPos(N, -1);
        for (int value = 0; value < N; ++value) {
            if (valPos[value] != -1) {
                reversedValPos[value] = N - 1 - valPos[value];
            }
        }
        solver.valPos = move(reversedValPos);

        answer = addmod(answer, solver.run(fact, invfact, pow2));
        cout << answer << '\n';
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

static const int MOD = 1000000007;
static const int MAXN = 2000;

long long modpow(long long a, long long e) {
    long long r = 1;
    while (e) {
        if (e & 1) r = r * a % MOD;
        a = a * a % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return r;
}

long long fact[MAXN + 1], invfact[MAXN + 1], pw2[MAXN + 1];

long long C(int n, int r) {
    if (r < 0 || r > n || n < 0) return 0;
    return fact[n] * invfact[r] % MOD * invfact[n - r] % MOD;
}

struct Tok {
    int type; // 0 = low, 1 = high, 2 = middle
    int x;    // low index, or high index
};

struct LC {
    int pos;
    Tok tok;
};

// Number of assignments for a component starting at its minimum low value.
int countS(int n, const vector<LC>& cs) {
    if (n == 1) {
        for (const auto& c : cs) {
            if (c.pos == 0) {
                if (c.tok.type != 0 || c.tok.x != 0) return 0;
            } else if (c.pos == 1) {
                if (c.tok.type != 1 || c.tok.x != 1) return 0;
            } else {
                return 0;
            }
        }
        return 1;
    }

    vector<int> head(n, -1), nxt(cs.size(), -1), peak;

    for (int id = 0; id < (int)cs.size(); ++id) {
        const auto& c = cs[id];
        int k = -1;
        if (c.tok.type == 0) {
            int l = c.tok.x;
            if (l == 0) {
                if (c.pos != 0) return 0;
                continue;
            } else if (l == n - 1) {
                peak.push_back(id);
                continue;
            } else {
                k = l;
            }
        } else if (c.tok.type == 1) {
            int r = c.tok.x;
            if (r >= n - 1) {
                peak.push_back(id);
                continue;
            } else {
                k = r;
            }
        } else {
            return 0;
        }

        if (k < 1 || k > n - 2) return 0;
        nxt[id] = head[k];
        head[k] = id;
    }

    auto matchOrdinary = [&](int k, const LC& c, int pref, int side) {
        int base;
        if (side == 1) {
            base = (c.tok.type == 1 ? 1 : 2);
        } else {
            base = 2 * (n - k) + (c.tok.type == 1 ? 1 : 0);
        }
        return c.pos == base + 2 * pref;
    };

    auto generate = [&](int k, const LC& c, int out[2]) {
        int cnt = 0;
        for (int side = 0; side <= 1; ++side) {
            int base;
            if (side == 1) {
                base = (c.tok.type == 1 ? 1 : 2);
            } else {
                base = 2 * (n - k) + (c.tok.type == 1 ? 1 : 0);
            }
            int dif = c.pos - base;
            if (dif >= 0 && dif % 2 == 0) {
                int pref = dif / 2;
                if (0 <= pref && pref <= k - 1) {
                    out[cnt++] = pref * 2 + side;
                }
            }
        }
        return cnt;
    };

    int prevK = -1, prevN = 0;
    int prevD[4];
    long long prevW[4] = {};

    for (int k = 1; k <= n - 2; ++k) {
        if (head[k] == -1) continue;

        int allowed[4], na = 0;
        int first = head[k];
        na = generate(k, cs[first], allowed);

        for (int id = nxt[first]; id != -1; id = nxt[id]) {
            int filtered[4], nf = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < na; ++j) {
                int pref = allowed[j] / 2;
                int side = allowed[j] % 2;
                if (matchOrdinary(k, cs[id], pref, side)) {
                    filtered[nf++] = allowed[j];
                }
            }
            na = nf;
            for (int j = 0; j < na; ++j) allowed[j] = filtered[j];
        }
        if (na == 0) return 0;

        int newD[4], newN = 0;
        long long newW[4] = {};

        for (int j = 0; j < na; ++j) {
            int pref = allowed[j] / 2;
            int side = allowed[j] % 2;
            long long ways = 0;

            if (prevK == -1) {
                ways = C(k - 1, pref);
            } else {
                int gap = k - prevK - 1;
                for (int z = 0; z < prevN; ++z) {
                    ways += prevW[z] * C(gap, pref - prevD[z]) % MOD;
                }
                ways %= MOD;
            }

            int after = pref + side;
            int at = -1;
            for (int z = 0; z < newN; ++z) {
                if (newD[z] == after) {
                    at = z;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (at == -1) {
                at = newN++;
                newD[at] = after;
            }
            newW[at] = (newW[at] + ways) % MOD;
        }

        prevN = newN;
        prevK = k;
        for (int z = 0; z < prevN; ++z) {
            prevD[z] = newD[z];
            prevW[z] = newW[z];
        }
    }

    auto waysWithTotal = [&](int total) -> long long {
        if (prevK == -1) return C(n - 2, total);
        int remaining = n - 2 - prevK;
        long long res = 0;
        for (int z = 0; z < prevN; ++z) {
            res += prevW[z] * C(remaining, total - prevD[z]) % MOD;
        }
        return res % MOD;
    };

    long long answer = 0;

    if (peak.empty()) {
        for (int total = 0; total <= n - 2; ++total) {
            answer += 2 * waysWithTotal(total) % MOD;
        }
        return answer % MOD;
    }

    vector<int> masks(n - 1, 3);

    for (int id : peak) {
        const auto& c = cs[id];
        for (int total = 0; total <= n - 2; ++total) {
            int cur = 0;
            if (c.tok.type == 0) {
                if (c.pos == 2 + 2 * total) cur = 3;
            } else if (c.tok.x == n - 1) {
                if (c.pos == 1 + 2 * total) cur |= 1;
                if (c.pos == 3 + 2 * total) cur |= 2;
            } else {
                if (c.pos == 3 + 2 * total) cur |= 1;
                if (c.pos == 1 + 2 * total) cur |= 2;
            }
            masks[total] &= cur;
        }
    }

    for (int total = 0; total <= n - 2; ++total) {
        if (masks[total]) {
            int cnt = (masks[total] & 1) + ((masks[total] >> 1) & 1);
            answer += waysWithTotal(total) * cnt % MOD;
        }
    }
    return answer % MOD;
}

// Pair type, with exactly b ordinary blocks before the core [0,M,H_m].
int countPair(int m, int b, const vector<LC>& cs) {
    vector<int> head(m, -1), nxt(cs.size(), -1);

    for (int id = 0; id < (int)cs.size(); ++id) {
        const auto& c = cs[id];
        int k = -1;

        if (c.tok.type == 2) {
            if (c.pos != 2 * b + 1) return 0;
            continue;
        }
        if (c.tok.type == 0 && c.tok.x == 0) {
            if (c.pos != 2 * b) return 0;
            continue;
        }
        if (c.tok.type == 1 && c.tok.x == m) {
            if (c.pos != 2 * b + 2) return 0;
            continue;
        }

        k = c.tok.x;
        if (k < 1 || k > m - 1) return 0;
        nxt[id] = head[k];
        head[k] = id;
    }

    auto matchOrdinary = [&](int k, const LC& c, int greater, int side) {
        int g = m - 1 - k;
        int expected;
        if (side == 1) {
            expected = (c.tok.type == 1 ? 1 : 0) + 2 * greater;
        } else {
            expected = 2 * b + 3 + 2 * g +
                       (c.tok.type == 1 ? 1 : 0) - 2 * greater;
        }
        return c.pos == expected;
    };

    auto generate = [&](int k, const LC& c, int out[2]) {
        int cnt = 0;
        int g = m - 1 - k;
        for (int side = 0; side <= 1; ++side) {
            int greater = -1;
            if (side == 1) {
                int base = (c.tok.type == 1 ? 1 : 0);
                int dif = c.pos - base;
                if (dif >= 0 && dif % 2 == 0) greater = dif / 2;
            } else {
                int base = 2 * b + 3 + 2 * g +
                           (c.tok.type == 1 ? 1 : 0);
                int dif = base - c.pos;
                if (dif >= 0 && dif % 2 == 0) greater = dif / 2;
            }
            if (0 <= greater && greater <= g) {
                out[cnt++] = greater * 2 + side;
            }
        }
        return cnt;
    };

    int prevK = -1, prevN = 0;
    int prevD[4];
    long long prevW[4] = {};

    for (int k = m - 1; k >= 1; --k) {
        if (head[k] == -1) continue;

        int allowed[4];
        int first = head[k];
        int na = generate(k, cs[first], allowed);

        for (int id = nxt[first]; id != -1; id = nxt[id]) {
            int filtered[4], nf = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < na; ++j) {
                int greater = allowed[j] / 2;
                int side = allowed[j] % 2;
                if (matchOrdinary(k, cs[id], greater, side)) {
                    filtered[nf++] = allowed[j];
                }
            }
            na = nf;
            for (int j = 0; j < na; ++j) allowed[j] = filtered[j];
        }
        if (na == 0) return 0;

        int newD[4], newN = 0;
        long long newW[4] = {};

        for (int j = 0; j < na; ++j) {
            int greater = allowed[j] / 2;
            int side = allowed[j] % 2;
            long long ways = 0;

            if (prevK == -1) {
                ways = C(m - 1 - k, greater);
            } else {
                int gap = prevK - k - 1;
                for (int z = 0; z < prevN; ++z) {
                    ways += prevW[z] * C(gap, greater - prevD[z]) % MOD;
                }
                ways %= MOD;
            }

            int after = greater + side;
            int at = -1;
            for (int z = 0; z < newN; ++z) {
                if (newD[z] == after) {
                    at = z;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (at == -1) {
                at = newN++;
                newD[at] = after;
            }
            newW[at] = (newW[at] + ways) % MOD;
        }

        prevN = newN;
        prevK = k;
        for (int z = 0; z < prevN; ++z) {
            prevD[z] = newD[z];
            prevW[z] = newW[z];
        }
    }

    if (prevK == -1) return C(m - 1, b);

    long long answer = 0;
    for (int z = 0; z < prevN; ++z) {
        answer += prevW[z] * C(prevK - 1, b - prevD[z]) % MOD;
    }
    return answer % MOD;
}

bool addS(vector<LC>& out, int pos, int value, int n, int offset, int mid) {
    Tok t;
    if (value < mid) {
        int l = value - offset;
        if (l < 0 || l >= n) return false;
        t = {0, l};
    } else if (value > mid) {
        int r = value - mid - offset;
        if (r < 1 || r > n) return false;
        t = {1, r};
    } else {
        return false;
    }
    out.push_back({pos, t});
    return true;
}

bool addE(vector<LC>& out, int pos, int value, int n, int offset, int mid) {
    int qpos = 2 * n - 1 - pos;
    Tok t;
    if (value < mid) {
        int l = value - offset;
        if (l < 0 || l >= n) return false;
        t = {1, n - l};
    } else if (value > mid) {
        int r = value - mid - offset;
        if (r < 1 || r > n) return false;
        t = {0, n - r};
    } else {
        return false;
    }
    out.push_back({qpos, t});
    return true;
}

int solveOddLH(int m, const vector<pair<int,int>>& constraints) {
    long long answer = 0;

    // Middle value at the left endpoint.
    {
        vector<LC> cs;
        bool ok = true;
        for (auto [pos, value] : constraints) {
            if (pos == 0) {
                if (value != m) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }
            } else if (!addS(cs, pos - 1, value, m, 0, m)) {
                ok = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (ok) answer += countS(m, cs);
    }

    // Middle value at the right endpoint.
    {
        vector<LC> cs;
        bool ok = true;
        for (auto [pos, value] : constraints) {
            if (pos == 2 * m) {
                if (value != m) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }
            } else if (!addE(cs, pos, value, m, 0, m)) {
                ok = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (ok) answer += countS(m, cs);
    }

    vector<LC> all;
    for (auto [pos, value] : constraints) {
        Tok t;
        if (value == m) t = {2, 0};
        else if (value < m) t = {0, value};
        else t = {1, value - m};
        all.push_back({pos, t});
    }

    // The middle value lies between 0 and H_m.
    for (int b = 0; b <= m - 1; ++b) {
        answer += countPair(m, b, all);
    }
    answer %= MOD;

    // The middle value lies on an edge H_m -> 0.
    for (int s = 1; s <= m - 1; ++s) {
        int u = m - s;
        vector<LC> upper, lower;
        bool ok = true;

        for (auto [pos, value] : constraints) {
            if (pos < 2 * u) {
                if (!addE(upper, pos, value, u, s, m)) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }
            } else if (pos == 2 * u) {
                if (value != m) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }
            } else {
                if (!addS(lower, pos - 2 * u - 1, value, s, 0, m)) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        if (ok) {
            long long a = countS(u, upper);
            if (a) {
                long long b = countS(s, lower);
                answer += a * b % MOD;
            }
        }
    }

    return answer % MOD;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= MAXN; ++i) fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % MOD;
    invfact[MAXN] = modpow(fact[MAXN], MOD - 2);
    for (int i = MAXN; i >= 1; --i) {
        invfact[i - 1] = invfact[i] * i % MOD;
    }
    pw2[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= MAXN; ++i) pw2[i] = pw2[i - 1] * 2 % MOD;

    int T, N;
    cin >> T >> N;

    while (T--) {
        int K;
        cin >> K;
        vector<pair<int,int>> constraints(K);
        for (auto& [i, j] : constraints) cin >> i >> j;

        if (N % 2 == 0) {
            int m = N / 2;
            vector<int> a(N);
            for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
                if (i % 2 == 0) a[i] = m + i / 2;
                else a[i] = i / 2;
            }

            int answer = 0;
            for (int rev = 0; rev < 2; ++rev) {
                bool ok = true;
                for (auto [pos, value] : constraints) {
                    int expected = rev ? a[N - 1 - pos] : a[pos];
                    if (expected != value) {
                        ok = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (ok) ++answer;
            }
            cout << answer << '\n';
        } else {
            int m = N / 2;
            if (K == 0) {
                long long answer = (m + 5LL) % MOD * pw2[m - 1] % MOD;
                cout << answer << '\n';
                continue;
            }

            vector<pair<int,int>> reversedConstraints;
            reversedConstraints.reserve(K);
            for (auto [pos, value] : constraints) {
                reversedConstraints.push_back({N - 1 - pos, value});
            }

            int answer = solveOddLH(m, constraints);
            answer += solveOddLH(m, reversedConstraints);
            answer %= MOD;
            cout << answer << '\n';
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

static const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;

int N, M;
vector<long long> factv, invfactv, pow2v;
vector<int> wantPos, wantVal;

long long modpow(long long a, long long e) {
    long long r = 1;
    while (e) {
        if (e & 1) r = r * a % MOD;
        a = a * a % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return r;
}

long long comb(int n, int k) {
    if (k < 0 || k > n || n < 0) return 0;
    return factv[n] * invfactv[k] % MOD * invfactv[n - k] % MOD;
}

bool fixedOK(int v, int pos) {
    if (pos < 0 || pos >= N) return false;
    if (wantVal[v] != -1 && wantVal[v] != pos) return false;
    if (wantPos[pos] != -1 && wantPos[pos] != v) return false;
    return true;
}

// type 0: [q, M+q], type 1: [M+q, q].
bool tokenOK(int q, int type, int start) {
    if (type == 0) {
        return fixedOK(q, start) && fixedOK(M + q, start + 1);
    } else {
        return fixedOK(M + q, start) && fixedOK(q, start + 1);
    }
}

struct Event {
    int t, q;
};

struct Layout {
    int kind;       // 0: generic two-sided layout, 1: form with two F-blocks sides
    int leftBase;
    int rightEnd;
    int rightBase;
    int selectedType;
    int unselectedType;
};

int placementStart(const Layout& lay, bool selected, int c, int t) {
    if (lay.kind == 0) {
        if (selected) return lay.leftBase + 2 * c;
        return lay.rightEnd - 2 * (t - c + 1);
    } else {
        if (selected) return 2 * c;
        return lay.rightBase + 2 * (t - c);
    }
}

bool getCandidate(const Layout& lay, bool selected, int q, int t, int& cOut) {
    int type = selected ? lay.selectedType : lay.unselectedType;
    int start = -1;

    if (wantVal[q] != -1) {
        int offset = (type == 0 ? 0 : 1);
        start = wantVal[q] - offset;
    } else if (wantVal[M + q] != -1) {
        int offset = (type == 0 ? 1 : 0);
        start = wantVal[M + q] - offset;
    } else {
        return false;
    }

    int c = -1;
    if (lay.kind == 0) {
        if (selected) {
            int diff = start - lay.leftBase;
            if (diff < 0 || (diff & 1)) return false;
            c = diff / 2;
        } else {
            int diff = lay.rightEnd - start;
            if (diff <= 0 || (diff & 1)) return false;
            c = t + 1 - diff / 2;
        }
    } else {
        if (selected) {
            if (start < 0 || (start & 1)) return false;
            c = start / 2;
        } else {
            int diff = start - lay.rightBase;
            if (diff < 0 || (diff & 1)) return false;
            c = t - diff / 2;
        }
    }

    if (c < 0 || c > t) return false;
    int actualStart = placementStart(lay, selected, c, t);
    if (actualStart != start) return false;
    if (!tokenOK(q, type, start)) return false;

    cOut = c;
    return true;
}

long long countAssignments(int h, const vector<Event>& events,
                           int totalRequired, const Layout& lay) {
    if (totalRequired > h) return 0;

    vector<pair<int, long long>> states;
    states.push_back({0, 1});
    int processed = 0;

    for (const Event& ev : events) {
        int gap = ev.t - processed;
        vector<pair<int, long long>> nextStates;

        for (int sel = 0; sel <= 1; ++sel) {
            int c;
            if (!getCandidate(lay, sel, ev.q, ev.t, c)) continue;

            long long ways = 0;
            for (auto [oldC, oldWays] : states) {
                ways = (ways + oldWays * comb(gap, c - oldC)) % MOD;
            }
            if (!ways) continue;

            int newC = c + sel;
            bool merged = false;
            for (auto& entry : nextStates) {
                if (entry.first == newC) {
                    entry.second = (entry.second + ways) % MOD;
                    merged = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!merged) nextStates.push_back({newC, ways});
        }

        if (nextStates.empty()) return 0;
        states.swap(nextStates);
        processed = ev.t + 1;
    }

    int remaining = h - processed;
    long long answer = 0;

    if (totalRequired == -1) {
        for (auto [c, ways] : states) {
            answer = (answer + ways * pow2v[remaining]) % MOD;
        }
    } else {
        for (auto [c, ways] : states) {
            answer = (answer + ways * comb(remaining, totalRequired - c)) % MOD;
        }
    }
    return answer;
}

vector<Event> makeEvents(int lo, int hi, int mode) {
    vector<Event> events;
    if (lo > hi) return events;

    if (mode == 0) {
        for (int q = hi; q >= lo; --q) {
            if (wantVal[q] != -1 || wantVal[M + q] != -1) {
                events.push_back({hi - q, q});
            }
        }
    } else {
        for (int q = lo; q <= hi; ++q) {
            if (wantVal[q] != -1 || wantVal[M + q] != -1) {
                events.push_back({q - lo, q});
            }
        }
    }
    return events;
}

// F/R two-sided layout with one variable-position middle token.
long long genericCount(int lo, int hi, int leftBase, int rightEnd,
                       int middleValue, int mode) {
    int h = max(0, hi - lo + 1);
    vector<Event> events = makeEvents(lo, hi, mode);

    int totalRequired = -1;
    if (wantVal[middleValue] != -1) {
        int pos = wantVal[middleValue];
        int diff = pos - leftBase;
        if (diff < 0 || (diff & 1)) return 0;
        totalRequired = diff / 2;
        if (totalRequired < 0 || totalRequired > h) return 0;
        if (!fixedOK(middleValue, pos)) return 0;
    }

    Layout lay;
    lay.kind = 0;
    lay.leftBase = leftBase;
    lay.rightEnd = rightEnd;
    lay.rightBase = 0;

    if (mode == 0) {
        lay.selectedType = 0;
        lay.unselectedType = 1;
    } else {
        lay.selectedType = 1;
        lay.unselectedType = 0;
    }

    return countAssignments(h, events, totalRequired, lay);
}

long long countCanonicalOdd() {
    int h = M - 1;
    long long answer = 0;

    // [M,0], R(Q) increasing, N-1, F(S) decreasing.
    if (fixedOK(M, 0) && fixedOK(0, 1)) {
        answer += genericCount(1, M - 1, 2, N, N - 1, 1);
    }

    // F(P) decreasing, [0,M,N-1], F(S) decreasing.
    vector<Event> middleEvents = makeEvents(1, M - 1, 0);
    for (int p = 0; p <= h; ++p) {
        int a = 2 * p;
        if (!fixedOK(0, a) || !fixedOK(M, a + 1) ||
            !fixedOK(N - 1, a + 2)) {
            continue;
        }

        Layout lay;
        lay.kind = 1;
        lay.leftBase = 0;
        lay.rightEnd = 0;
        lay.rightBase = 2 * p + 3;
        lay.selectedType = 0;
        lay.unselectedType = 0;

        answer += countAssignments(h, middleEvents, p, lay);
        if (answer >= MOD) answer -= MOD;
    }

    // F(P) decreasing, 0, R(Q) increasing, [N-1,M].
    if (fixedOK(N - 1, N - 2) && fixedOK(M, N - 1)) {
        answer += genericCount(1, M - 1, 0, N - 2, 0, 0);
    }
    answer %= MOD;

    // Defective forms, containing [N-1,M,0].
    for (int d = 1; d <= M - 1; ++d) {
        int highCount = M - 1 - d;
        int posB = 2 * highCount + 1;

        if (!fixedOK(N - 1, posB) ||
            !fixedOK(M, posB + 1) ||
            !fixedOK(0, posB + 2)) {
            continue;
        }

        long long highWays = genericCount(
            d + 1, M - 1, 0, posB, d, 0
        );
        if (!highWays) continue;

        long long lowWays = genericCount(
            1, d - 1, posB + 3, N, M + d, 1
        );

        answer = (answer + highWays * lowWays) % MOD;
    }

    return answer;
}

long long countCanonicalEven() {
    vector<int> seq;
    seq.reserve(N);
    for (int k = 0; k < M; ++k) {
        seq.push_back(M - 1 - k);
        seq.push_back(2 * M - 1 - k);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        if (wantPos[i] != -1 && wantPos[i] != seq[i]) return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

long long solveCanonical(const vector<pair<int, int>>& constraints, bool reversed) {
    wantPos.assign(N, -1);
    wantVal.assign(N, -1);

    for (auto [i, j] : constraints) {
        int pos = reversed ? N - 1 - i : i;
        wantPos[pos] = j;
        wantVal[j] = pos;
    }

    if (N % 2 == 0) return countCanonicalEven();
    return countCanonicalOdd();
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int T;
    cin >> T >> N;
    M = N / 2;

    factv.assign(N + 1, 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
        factv[i] = factv[i - 1] * i % MOD;
    }
    invfactv.assign(N + 1, 1);
    invfactv[N] = modpow(factv[N], MOD - 2);
    for (int i = N; i >= 1; --i) {
        invfactv[i - 1] = invfactv[i] * i % MOD;
    }

    pow2v.assign(N + 1, 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
        pow2v[i] = pow2v[i - 1] * 2 % MOD;
    }

    while (T--) {
        int K;
        cin >> K;
        vector<pair<int, int>> constraints(K);
        for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
            cin >> constraints[i].first >> constraints[i].second;
        }

        long long answer = solveCanonical(constraints, false);
        answer += solveCanonical(constraints, true);
        answer %= MOD;
        cout << answer << '\n';
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using int64 = long long;
static const int MOD = 1000000007;

int addmod(int a, int b) {
    int s = a + b;
    if (s >= MOD) s -= MOD;
    return s;
}

struct Option {
    int col;
    int req;
};

struct StageOptions {
    int t;
    int n;
    array<Option, 2> op;
};

struct Spec {
    array<int, 2> val;
    array<int, 2> offset;
    int base;
    int step;
    int maxReq;
};

struct Solver {
    int N, m, u;
    vector<int> valPos;

    int binom(int n, int k, const vector<int64>& fact, const vector<int64>& invfact) const {
        if (k < 0 || k > n || n < 0) return 0;
        return int(fact[n] * invfact[k] % MOD * invfact[n - k] % MOD);
    }

    int countChoices(int stages, const vector<StageOptions>& cs, int total,
                     const vector<int64>& fact, const vector<int64>& invfact,
                     const vector<int>& pow2) const {
        if (cs.empty()) {
            if (total == -1) return pow2[stages];
            return binom(stages, total, fact, invfact);
        }

        array<int64, 2> dp{}, ndp{};

        const StageOptions& first = cs.front();
        for (int i = 0; i < first.n; ++i) {
            dp[i] = binom(first.t, first.op[i].req, fact, invfact);
        }
        int prevN = first.n;
        StageOptions prev = first;

        for (int z = 1; z < (int)cs.size(); ++z) {
            const StageOptions& cur = cs[z];
            ndp = {0, 0};
            int gap = cur.t - prev.t - 1;

            for (int i = 0; i < prevN; ++i) {
                if (!dp[i]) continue;
                int before = prev.op[i].req + (prev.op[i].col == 1);
                for (int j = 0; j < cur.n; ++j) {
                    int need = cur.op[j].req - before;
                    int ways = binom(gap, need, fact, invfact);
                    ndp[j] = (ndp[j] + dp[i] * ways) % MOD;
                }
            }

            dp = ndp;
            prevN = cur.n;
            prev = cur;
        }

        int suffix = stages - 1 - prev.t;
        int64 ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < prevN; ++i) {
            if (!dp[i]) continue;
            int before = prev.op[i].req + (prev.op[i].col == 1);
            if (total == -1) {
                ans = (ans + dp[i] * pow2[suffix]) % MOD;
            } else {
                int need = total - before;
                ans = (ans + dp[i] * binom(suffix, need, fact, invfact)) % MOD;
            }
        }
        return int(ans);
    }

    bool addStage(vector<StageOptions>& cs, int t, int off,
                  const array<Spec, 2>& spec) const {
        bool constrained = false;
        for (int k = 0; k < 2; ++k) {
            if (valPos[spec[0].val[k]] != -1) constrained = true;
        }
        if (!constrained) return true;

        StageOptions so;
        so.t = t;
        so.n = 0;

        for (int col = 0; col < 2; ++col) {
            bool ok = true;
            int requirement = -1;

            for (int k = 0; k < 2 && ok; ++k) {
                int value = spec[col].val[k];
                int p = valPos[value];
                if (p == -1) continue;

                int64 local = (int64)p - off;
                int64 start = local - spec[col].offset[k];
                int64 diff = start - spec[col].base;
                int step = spec[col].step;

                if (diff % step != 0) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }

                int64 req = diff / step;
                if (req < 0 || req > spec[col].maxReq) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }

                if (requirement != -1 && requirement != req) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }
                requirement = int(req);
            }

            if (ok) {
                so.op[so.n++] = {col, requirement};
            }
        }

        if (so.n == 0) return false;
        cs.push_back(so);
        return true;
    }

    int fixedAt(int value, int position) const {
        return valPos[value] == -1 || valPos[value] == position;
    }

    int countA(int s, int off,
               const vector<int64>& fact, const vector<int64>& invfact,
               const vector<int>& pow2) const {
        int stages = s - 1;

        if (!fixedAt(0, off)) return 0;

        int total = -1;
        int markValue = m + s;
        if (valPos[markValue] != -1) {
            int local = valPos[markValue] - off;
            if (local < 1 || (local - 1) % 2 != 0) return 0;
            total = (local - 1) / 2;
            if (total < 0 || total > stages) return 0;
        }

        vector<StageOptions> cs;
        for (int r = 1; r <= stages; ++r) {
            int L = r;
            int H = m + r;

            array<Spec, 2> spec;

            // Color 0: L, pair (L_r,H_r), start = 2(s-r)+2a.
            spec[0].val = {L, H};
            spec[0].offset = {0, 1};
            spec[0].base = 2 * (s - r);
            spec[0].step = 2;
            spec[0].maxReq = r - 1;

            // Color 1: R, pair (H_r,L_r), start = 1+2a.
            spec[1].val = {H, L};
            spec[1].offset = {0, 1};
            spec[1].base = 1;
            spec[1].step = 2;
            spec[1].maxReq = r - 1;

            if (!addStage(cs, r - 1, off, spec)) return 0;
        }

        return countChoices(stages, cs, total, fact, invfact, pow2);
    }

    int countB(const vector<int64>& fact, const vector<int64>& invfact,
               const vector<int>& pow2) const {
        int stages = m - 1;

        if (!fixedAt(2 * m, 2 * m - 1)) return 0;

        int total = -1;
        if (valPos[0] != -1) {
            int local = valPos[0];
            if (local < 0 || local % 2 != 0) return 0;
            total = local / 2;
            if (total < 0 || total > stages) return 0;
        }

        vector<StageOptions> cs;
        for (int t = 0; t < stages; ++t) {
            int r = stages - t;
            int L = r;
            int H = m + r;

            array<Spec, 2> spec;

            // Color 0: R, pair (H_r,L_r), start = 2r-1+2x.
            spec[0].val = {H, L};
            spec[0].offset = {0, 1};
            spec[0].base = 2 * r - 1;
            spec[0].step = 2;
            spec[0].maxReq = stages - r;

            // Color 1: D, pair (L_r,H_r), start = 2x.
            spec[1].val = {L, H};
            spec[1].offset = {0, 1};
            spec[1].base = 0;
            spec[1].step = 2;
            spec[1].maxReq = stages - r;

            if (!addStage(cs, t, 0, spec)) return 0;
        }

        return countChoices(stages, cs, total, fact, invfact, pow2);
    }

    int countQ0(int T, const vector<int64>& fact, const vector<int64>& invfact,
                const vector<int>& pow2) const {
        if (!fixedAt(0, 2 * T)) return 0;
        if (!fixedAt(m, 2 * T + 1)) return 0;
        if (!fixedAt(2 * m, 2 * T + 2)) return 0;

        vector<StageOptions> cs;
        for (int r = 1; r <= u; ++r) {
            int L = r;
            int H = m + r;

            array<Spec, 2> spec;

            // Color 0: A, start = 2u-2r+3+2b.
            spec[0].val = {L, H};
            spec[0].offset = {0, 1};
            spec[0].base = 2 * u - 2 * r + 3;
            spec[0].step = 2;
            spec[0].maxReq = r - 1;

            // Color 1: B, start = 2(T-1)-2b.
            spec[1].val = {L, H};
            spec[1].offset = {0, 1};
            spec[1].base = 2 * T - 2;
            spec[1].step = -2;
            spec[1].maxReq = r - 1;

            if (!addStage(cs, r - 1, 0, spec)) return 0;
        }

        return countChoices(u, cs, T, fact, invfact, pow2);
    }

    int countLate(int s, const vector<int64>& fact, const vector<int64>& invfact,
                  const vector<int>& pow2) const {
        int lateStages = u - s;

        int total = -1;
        if (valPos[s] != -1) {
            int p = valPos[s];
            if (p < 0 || p % 2 != 0) return 0;
            total = p / 2;
            if (total < 0 || total > lateStages) return 0;
        }

        vector<StageOptions> cs;
        for (int t = 0; t < lateStages; ++t) {
            int r = u - t;
            int L = r;
            int H = m + r;

            array<Spec, 2> spec;

            // Color 0: A, pair (H_r,L_r).
            spec[0].val = {H, L};
            spec[0].offset = {0, 1};
            spec[0].base = 2 * r - 2 * s - 1;
            spec[0].step = 2;
            spec[0].maxReq = u - r;

            // Color 1: B, pair (L_r,H_r).
            spec[1].val = {L, H};
            spec[1].offset = {0, 1};
            spec[1].base = 0;
            spec[1].step = 2;
            spec[1].maxReq = u - r;

            if (!addStage(cs, t, 0, spec)) return 0;
        }

        return countChoices(lateStages, cs, total, fact, invfact, pow2);
    }

    int run(const vector<int64>& fact, const vector<int64>& invfact,
            const vector<int>& pow2) const {
        int64 ans = 0;

        // Center prepended, base path of type A.
        if (fixedAt(m, 0)) {
            ans += countA(m, 1, fact, invfact, pow2);
        }

        // Center appended, base path of type B.
        if (fixedAt(m, 2 * m)) {
            ans += countB(fact, invfact, pow2);
        }

        // Internal center, orientation 0,center,H_m.
        for (int T = 0; T <= u; ++T) {
            ans += countQ0(T, fact, invfact, pow2);
            if (ans >= MOD) ans -= MOD;
        }

        // Internal center, orientation H_m,center,0.
        for (int s = 1; s <= u; ++s) {
            int v = u - s;
            if (!fixedAt(2 * m, 2 * v + 1)) continue;
            if (!fixedAt(m, 2 * v + 2)) continue;

            int early = countA(s, 2 * v + 3, fact, invfact, pow2);
            if (!early) continue;
            int late = countLate(s, fact, invfact, pow2);
            ans = (ans + (int64)early * late) % MOD;
        }

        return int(ans % MOD);
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int T, N;
    cin >> T >> N;

    vector<int64> fact(N + 1), invfact(N + 1);

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

static const int MOD = 1000000007;
static const int MAXN = 2000;

long long modpow(long long a, long long e) {
    long long r = 1;
    while (e) {
        if (e & 1) r = r * a % MOD;
        a = a * a % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return r;
}

long long fact[MAXN + 1], invfact[MAXN + 1], pw2[MAXN + 1];

long long C(int n, int r) {
    if (r < 0 || r > n || n < 0) return 0;
    return fact[n] * invfact[r] % MOD * invfact[n - r] % MOD;
}

struct Tok {
    int type; // 0 = low, 1 = high, 2 = middle
    int x;    // low index, or high index
};

struct LC {
    int pos;
    Tok tok;
};

// Number of assignments for a component starting at its minimum low value.
int countS(int n, const vector<LC>& cs) {
    if (n == 1) {
        for (const auto& c : cs) {
            if (c.pos == 0) {
                if (c.tok.type != 0 || c.tok.x != 0) return 0;
            } else if (c.pos == 1) {
                if (c.tok.type != 1 || c.tok.x != 1) return 0;
            } else {
                return 0;
            }
        }
        return 1;
    }

    vector<int> head(n, -1), nxt(cs.size(), -1), peak;

    for (int id = 0; id < (int)cs.size(); ++id) {
        const auto& c = cs[id];
        int k = -1;
        if (c.tok.type == 0) {
            int l = c.tok.x;
            if (l == 0) {
                if (c.pos != 0) return 0;
                continue;
            } else if (l == n - 1) {
                peak.push_back(id);
                continue;
            } else {
                k = l;
            }
        } else if (c.tok.type == 1) {
            int r = c.tok.x;
            if (r >= n - 1) {
                peak.push_back(id);
                continue;
            } else {
                k = r;
            }
        } else {
            return 0;
        }

        if (k < 1 || k > n - 2) return 0;
        nxt[id] = head[k];
        head[k] = id;
    }

    auto matchOrdinary = [&](int k, const LC& c, int pref, int side) {
        int base;
        if (side == 1) {
            base = (c.tok.type == 1 ? 1 : 2);
        } else {
            base = 2 * (n - k) + (c.tok.type == 1 ? 1 : 0);
        }
        return c.pos == base + 2 * pref;
    };

    auto generate = [&](int k, const LC& c, int out[2]) {
        int cnt = 0;
        for (int side = 0; side <= 1; ++side) {
            int base;
            if (side == 1) {
                base = (c.tok.type == 1 ? 1 : 2);
            } else {
                base = 2 * (n - k) + (c.tok.type == 1 ? 1 : 0);
            }
            int dif = c.pos - base;
            if (dif >= 0 && dif % 2 == 0) {
                int pref = dif / 2;
                if (0 <= pref && pref <= k - 1) {
                    out[cnt++] = pref * 2 + side;
                }
            }
        }
        return cnt;
    };

    int prevK = -1, prevN = 0;
    int prevD[4];
    long long prevW[4] = {};

    for (int k = 1; k <= n - 2; ++k) {
        if (head[k] == -1) continue;

        int allowed[4], na = 0;
        int first = head[k];
        na = generate(k, cs[first], allowed);

        for (int id = nxt[first]; id != -1; id = nxt[id]) {
            int filtered[4], nf = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < na; ++j) {
                int pref = allowed[j] / 2;
                int side = allowed[j] % 2;
                if (matchOrdinary(k, cs[id], pref, side)) {
                    filtered[nf++] = allowed[j];
                }
            }
            na = nf;
            for (int j = 0; j < na; ++j) allowed[j] = filtered[j];
        }
        if (na == 0) return 0;

        int newD[4], newN = 0;
        long long newW[4] = {};

        for (int j = 0; j < na; ++j) {
            int pref = allowed[j] / 2;
            int side = allowed[j] % 2;
            long long ways = 0;

            if (prevK == -1) {
                ways = C(k - 1, pref);
            } else {
                int gap = k - prevK - 1;
                for (int z = 0; z < prevN; ++z) {
                    ways += prevW[z] * C(gap, pref - prevD[z]) % MOD;
                }
                ways %= MOD;
            }

            int after = pref + side;
            int at = -1;
            for (int z = 0; z < newN; ++z) {
                if (newD[z] == after) {
                    at = z;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (at == -1) {
                at = newN++;
                newD[at] = after;
            }
            newW[at] = (newW[at] + ways) % MOD;
        }

        prevN = newN;
        prevK = k;
        for (int z = 0; z < prevN; ++z) {
            prevD[z] = newD[z];
            prevW[z] = newW[z];
        }
    }

    auto waysWithTotal = [&](int total) -> long long {
        if (prevK == -1) return C(n - 2, total);
        int remaining = n - 2 - prevK;
        long long res = 0;
        for (int z = 0; z < prevN; ++z) {
            res += prevW[z] * C(remaining, total - prevD[z]) % MOD;
        }
        return res % MOD;
    };

    long long answer = 0;

    if (peak.empty()) {
        for (int total = 0; total <= n - 2; ++total) {
            answer += 2 * waysWithTotal(total) % MOD;
        }
        return answer % MOD;
    }

    vector<int> masks(n - 1, 3);

    for (int id : peak) {
        const auto& c = cs[id];
        for (int total = 0; total <= n - 2; ++total) {
            int cur = 0;
            if (c.tok.type == 0) {
                if (c.pos == 2 + 2 * total) cur = 3;
            } else if (c.tok.x == n - 1) {
                if (c.pos == 1 + 2 * total) cur |= 1;
                if (c.pos == 3 + 2 * total) cur |= 2;
            } else {
                if (c.pos == 3 + 2 * total) cur |= 1;
                if (c.pos == 1 + 2 * total) cur |= 2;
            }
            masks[total] &= cur;
        }
    }

    for (int total = 0; total <= n - 2; ++total) {
        if (masks[total]) {
            int cnt = (masks[total] & 1) + ((masks[total] >> 1) & 1);
            answer += waysWithTotal(total) * cnt % MOD;
        }
    }
    return answer % MOD;
}

// Pair type, with exactly b ordinary blocks before the core [0,M,H_m].
int countPair(int m, int b, const vector<LC>& cs) {
    vector<int> head(m, -1), nxt(cs.size(), -1);

    for (int id = 0; id < (int)cs.size(); ++id) {
        const auto& c = cs[id];
        int k = -1;

        if (c.tok.type == 2) {
            if (c.pos != 2 * b + 1) return 0;
            continue;
        }
        if (c.tok.type == 0 && c.tok.x == 0) {
            if (c.pos != 2 * b) return 0;
            continue;
        }
        if (c.tok.type == 1 && c.tok.x == m) {
            if (c.pos != 2 * b + 2) return 0;
            continue;
        }

        k = c.tok.x;
        if (k < 1 || k > m - 1) return 0;
        nxt[id] = head[k];
        head[k] = id;
    }

    auto matchOrdinary = [&](int k, const LC& c, int greater, int side) {
        int g = m - 1 - k;
        int expected;
        if (side == 1) {
            expected = (c.tok.type == 1 ? 1 : 0) + 2 * greater;
        } else {
            expected = 2 * b + 3 + 2 * g +
                       (c.tok.type == 1 ? 1 : 0) - 2 * greater;
        }
        return c.pos == expected;
    };

    auto generate = [&](int k, const LC& c, int out[2]) {
        int cnt = 0;
        int g = m - 1 - k;
        for (int side = 0; side <= 1; ++side) {
            int greater = -1;
            if (side == 1) {
                int base = (c.tok.type == 1 ? 1 : 0);
                int dif = c.pos - base;
                if (dif >= 0 && dif % 2 == 0) greater = dif / 2;
            } else {
                int base = 2 * b + 3 + 2 * g +
                           (c.tok.type == 1 ? 1 : 0);
                int dif = base - c.pos;
                if (dif >= 0 && dif % 2 == 0) greater = dif / 2;
            }
            if (0 <= greater && greater <= g) {
                out[cnt++] = greater * 2 + side;
            }
        }
        return cnt;
    };

    int prevK = -1, prevN = 0;
    int prevD[4];
    long long prevW[4] = {};

    for (int k = m - 1; k >= 1; --k) {
        if (head[k] == -1) continue;

        int allowed[4];
        int first = head[k];
        int na = generate(k, cs[first], allowed);

        for (int id = nxt[first]; id != -1; id = nxt[id]) {
            int filtered[4], nf = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < na; ++j) {
                int greater = allowed[j] / 2;
                int side = allowed[j] % 2;
                if (matchOrdinary(k, cs[id], greater, side)) {
                    filtered[nf++] = allowed[j];
                }
            }
            na = nf;
            for (int j = 0; j < na; ++j) allowed[j] = filtered[j];
        }
        if (na == 0) return 0;

        int newD[4], newN = 0;
        long long newW[4] = {};

        for (int j = 0; j < na; ++j) {
            int greater = allowed[j] / 2;
            int side = allowed[j] % 2;
            long long ways = 0;

            if (prevK == -1) {
                ways = C(m - 1 - k, greater);
            } else {
                int gap = prevK - k - 1;
                for (int z = 0; z < prevN; ++z) {
                    ways += prevW[z] * C(gap, greater - prevD[z]) % MOD;
                }
                ways %= MOD;
            }

            int after = greater + side;
            int at = -1;
            for (int z = 0; z < newN; ++z) {
                if (newD[z] == after) {
                    at = z;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (at == -1) {
                at = newN++;
                newD[at] = after;
            }
            newW[at] = (newW[at] + ways) % MOD;
        }

        prevN = newN;
        prevK = k;
        for (int z = 0; z < prevN; ++z) {
            prevD[z] = newD[z];
            prevW[z] = newW[z];
        }
    }

    if (prevK == -1) return C(m - 1, b);

    long long answer = 0;
    for (int z = 0; z < prevN; ++z) {
        answer += prevW[z] * C(prevK - 1, b - prevD[z]) % MOD;
    }
    return answer % MOD;
}

bool addS(vector<LC>& out, int pos, int value, int n, int offset, int mid) {
    Tok t;
    if (value < mid) {
        int l = value - offset;
        if (l < 0 || l >= n) return false;
        t = {0, l};
    } else if (value > mid) {
        int r = value - mid - offset;
        if (r < 1 || r > n) return false;
        t = {1, r};
    } else {
        return false;
    }
    out.push_back({pos, t});
    return true;
}

bool addE(vector<LC>& out, int pos, int value, int n, int offset, int mid) {
    int qpos = 2 * n - 1 - pos;
    Tok t;
    if (value < mid) {
        int l = value - offset;
        if (l < 0 || l >= n) return false;
        t = {1, n - l};
    } else if (value > mid) {
        int r = value - mid - offset;
        if (r < 1 || r > n) return false;
        t = {0, n - r};
    } else {
        return false;
    }
    out.push_back({qpos, t});
    return true;
}

int solveOddLH(int m, const vector<pair<int,int>>& constraints) {
    long long answer = 0;

    // Middle value at the left endpoint.
    {
        vector<LC> cs;
        bool ok = true;
        for (auto [pos, value] : constraints) {
            if (pos == 0) {
                if (value != m) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }
            } else if (!addS(cs, pos - 1, value, m, 0, m)) {
                ok = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (ok) answer += countS(m, cs);
    }

    // Middle value at the right endpoint.
    {
        vector<LC> cs;
        bool ok = true;
        for (auto [pos, value] : constraints) {
            if (pos == 2 * m) {
                if (value != m) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }
            } else if (!addE(cs, pos, value, m, 0, m)) {
                ok = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (ok) answer += countS(m, cs);
    }

    vector<LC> all;
    for (auto [pos, value] : constraints) {
        Tok t;
        if (value == m) t = {2, 0};
        else if (value < m) t = {0, value};
        else t = {1, value - m};
        all.push_back({pos, t});
    }

    // The middle value lies between 0 and H_m.
    for (int b = 0; b <= m - 1; ++b) {
        answer += countPair(m, b, all);
    }
    answer %= MOD;

    // The middle value lies on an edge H_m -> 0.
    for (int s = 1; s <= m - 1; ++s) {
        int u = m - s;
        vector<LC> upper, lower;
        bool ok = true;

        for (auto [pos, value] : constraints) {
            if (pos < 2 * u) {
                if (!addE(upper, pos, value, u, s, m)) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }
            } else if (pos == 2 * u) {
                if (value != m) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }
            } else {
                if (!addS(lower, pos - 2 * u - 1, value, s, 0, m)) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        if (ok) {
            long long a = countS(u, upper);
            if (a) {
                long long b = countS(s, lower);
                answer += a * b % MOD;
            }
        }
    }

    return answer % MOD;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= MAXN; ++i) fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % MOD;
    invfact[MAXN] = modpow(fact[MAXN], MOD - 2);
    for (int i = MAXN; i >= 1; --i) {
        invfact[i - 1] = invfact[i] * i % MOD;
    }
    pw2[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= MAXN; ++i) pw2[i] = pw2[i - 1] * 2 % MOD;

    int T, N;
    cin >> T >> N;

    while (T--) {
        int K;
        cin >> K;
        vector<pair<int,int>> constraints(K);
        for (auto& [i, j] : constraints) cin >> i >> j;

        if (N % 2 == 0) {
            int m = N / 2;
            vector<int> a(N);
            for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
                if (i % 2 == 0) a[i] = m + i / 2;
                else a[i] = i / 2;
            }

            int answer = 0;
            for (int rev = 0; rev < 2; ++rev) {
                bool ok = true;
                for (auto [pos, value] : constraints) {
                    int expected = rev ? a[N - 1 - pos] : a[pos];
                    if (expected != value) {
                        ok = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (ok) ++answer;
            }
            cout << answer << '\n';
        } else {
            int m = N / 2;
            if (K == 0) {
                long long answer = (m + 5LL) % MOD * pw2[m - 1] % MOD;
                cout << answer << '\n';
                continue;
            }

            vector<pair<int,int>> reversedConstraints;
            reversedConstraints.reserve(K);
            for (auto [pos, value] : constraints) {
                reversedConstraints.push_back({N - 1 - pos, value});
            }

            int answer = solveOddLH(m, constraints);
            answer += solveOddLH(m, reversedConstraints);
            answer %= MOD;
            cout << answer << '\n';
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
const int MOD = 1000000007;

long long modpow(long long a, long long e) {
    long long r = 1;
    while (e) {
        if (e & 1) r = r * a % MOD;
        a = a * a % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return r;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int T, N;
    cin >> T >> N;
    // For now, we output the total number of optimal permutations.
    // This does not handle constraints, but it is a placeholder.
    long long total;
    if (N % 2 == 0) {
        total = 2;
    } else {
        int m = N / 2;
        total = (m + 5) % MOD * modpow(2, m - 1) % MOD;
    }
    while (T--) {
        int K;
        cin >> K;
        for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
            int a, b;
            cin >> a >> b;
        }
        cout << total << '\n';
    }
    return 0;
}
