#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

static const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int T, N;
    cin >> T >> N;

    while (T--) {
        int K;
        cin >> K;

        vector<int> reqPos(N, -1), reqVal(N, -1);
        for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
            int p, v;
            cin >> p >> v;
            reqPos[p] = v;
            reqVal[v] = p;
        }

        auto checkPlace = [&](int pos, int val) -> bool {
            if (pos < 0 || pos >= N || val < 0 || val >= N) return false;
            if (reqPos[pos] != -1 && reqPos[pos] != val) return false;
            if (reqVal[val] != -1 && reqVal[val] != pos) return false;
            return true;
        };

        long long answer = 0;

        if (N % 2 == 0) {
            int m = N / 2;
            vector<int> seq1(N), seq2(N);

            for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
                seq1[2 * i] = m - 1 - i;
                seq1[2 * i + 1] = 2 * m - 1 - i;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) seq2[i] = seq1[N - 1 - i];

            auto good = [&](const vector<int>& p) -> bool {
                for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
                    if (reqPos[i] != -1 && reqPos[i] != p[i]) return false;
                    if (reqVal[p[i]] != -1 && reqVal[p[i]] != i) return false;
                }
                return true;
            };

            if (good(seq1)) ++answer;
            if (good(seq2)) ++answer;
            answer %= MOD;

            cout << answer << '\n';
            continue;
        }

        int m = N / 2; // N = 2m + 1
        long long typeA = 0, typeB = 0;

        // ---------- Type A : no 0-m adjacency ----------
        {
            vector<long long> dp(m + 1, 0), ndp(m + 1, 0);
            dp[0] = 1;

            for (int k = m; k >= 1; --k) {
                int processed = m - k;
                fill(ndp.begin(), ndp.end(), 0);

                for (int c = 0; c <= processed; ++c) {
                    if (!dp[c]) continue;

                    int l = 2 * c;
                    int rightCnt = processed - c;
                    int r = N - 1 - 2 * rightCnt;

                    // put k on the left: [k, m+k]
                    if (checkPlace(l, k) && checkPlace(l + 1, m + k)) {
                        ndp[c + 1] += dp[c];
                        if (ndp[c + 1] >= MOD) ndp[c + 1] -= MOD;
                    }

                    // put k on the right: [m+k, k]
                    if (checkPlace(r - 1, m + k) && checkPlace(r, k)) {
                        ndp[c] += dp[c];
                        if (ndp[c] >= MOD) ndp[c] -= MOD;
                    }
                }

                dp.swap(ndp);
            }

            int processed = m;
            for (int c = 0; c <= m; ++c) {
                if (!dp[c]) continue;
                int l = 2 * c;
                if (checkPlace(l, 0)) {
                    typeA += dp[c];
                    if (typeA >= MOD) typeA -= MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        // ---------- Type B : 0 and m adjacent ----------

        // B1: the special block [0,m,2m] is inserted between the two elements
        // of one chosen pair k.  We process all k together.
        if (m >= 2) {
            // used = 0 : not used yet
            // used = 1 : special block was placed on the left
            // used = 2 : special block was placed on the right
            vector<vector<long long>> dp(3, vector<long long>(m + 1, 0));
            vector<vector<long long>> ndp(3, vector<long long>(m + 1, 0));
            dp[0][0] = 1;

            for (int k = m - 1; k >= 1; --k) {
                int processed = (m - 1) - k;
                for (int u = 0; u < 3; ++u)
                    fill(ndp[u].begin(), ndp[u].end(), 0);

                for (int used = 0; used < 3; ++used) {
                    for (int c = 0; c <= processed; ++c) {
                        long long cur = dp[used][c];
                        if (!cur) continue;

                        int l = 2 * c + (used == 1 ? 3 : 0);
                        int rightCnt = processed - c;
                        int rightLen = 2 * rightCnt + (used == 2 ? 3 : 0);
                        int r = N - 1 - rightLen;

                        // normal left
                        if (checkPlace(l, k) && checkPlace(l + 1, m + k)) {
                            ndp[used][c + 1] += cur;
                            if (ndp[used][c + 1] >= MOD) ndp[used][c + 1] -= MOD;
                        }

                        // normal right
                        if (checkPlace(r - 1, m + k) && checkPlace(r, k)) {
                            ndp[used][c] += cur;
                            if (ndp[used][c] >= MOD) ndp[used][c] -= MOD;
                        }

                        if (used == 0) {
                            // special left block: [k, 2m, m, 0, m+k]
                            if (checkPlace(l, k) &&
                                checkPlace(l + 1, 2 * m) &&
                                checkPlace(l + 2, m) &&
                                checkPlace(l + 3, 0) &&
                                checkPlace(l + 4, m + k)) {
                                ndp[1][c + 1] += cur;
                                if (ndp[1][c + 1] >= MOD) ndp[1][c + 1] -= MOD;
                            }

                            // special right block: [m+k, 0, m, 2m, k]
                            if (checkPlace(r - 4, m + k) &&
                                checkPlace(r - 3, 0) &&
                                checkPlace(r - 2, m) &&
                                checkPlace(r - 1, 2 * m) &&
                                checkPlace(r, k)) {
                                ndp[2][c] += cur;
                                if (ndp[2][c] >= MOD) ndp[2][c] -= MOD;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                dp.swap(ndp);
            }

            int processed = m - 1;
            for (int used = 1; used <= 2; ++used) {
                for (int c = 0; c <= processed; ++c) {
                    typeB += dp[used][c];
                    typeB %= MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        // B2: the special values are placed at the two ends.
        if (m >= 2) {
            vector<int> perm = {0, m, 2 * m};

            do {
                for (int cut = 0; cut <= 3; ++cut) {
                    vector<int> pref, suff;
                    for (int i = 0; i < cut; ++i) pref.push_back(perm[i]);
                    for (int i = cut; i < 3; ++i) suff.push_back(perm[i]);

                    auto hasAdj = [&](const vector<int>& v) -> bool {
                        for (int i = 0; i + 1 < (int)v.size(); ++i) {
                            if ((v[i] == 0 && v[i + 1] == m) ||
                                (v[i] == m && v[i + 1] == 0))
                                return true;
                        }
                        return false;
                    };

                    if (!hasAdj(pref) && !hasAdj(suff)) continue;

                    bool ok = true;
                    for (int i = 0; i + 1 < (int)pref.size(); ++i)
                        if (abs(pref[i] - pref[i + 1]) < m) ok = false;
                    for (int i = 0; i + 1 < (int)suff.size(); ++i)
                        if (abs(suff[i] - suff[i + 1]) < m) ok = false;
                    if (!ok) continue;

                    int plen = (int)pref.size();
                    int slen = (int)suff.size();

                    // Check the already fixed special prefix/suffix against constraints.
                    for (int i = 0; i < plen; ++i) {
                        if (!checkPlace(i, pref[i])) ok = false;
                    }
                    for (int i = 0; i < slen; ++i) {
                        if (!checkPlace(N - slen + i, suff[i])) ok = false;
                    }
                    if (!ok) continue;

                    int leftBound = plen ? pref.back() : -1;
                    int rightBound = slen ? suff.front() : -1;

                    vector<long long> dp(m, 0), ndp(m, 0);
                    dp[0] = 1;

                    for (int k = m - 1; k >= 1; --k) {
                        int processed = (m - 1) - k;
                        fill(ndp.begin(), ndp.end(), 0);

                        for (int c = 0; c <= processed; ++c) {
                            long long cur = dp[c];
                            if (!cur) continue;

                            int l = plen + 2 * c;
                            int rightCnt = processed - c;
                            int r = N - 1 - slen - 2 * rightCnt;

                            // put k on the left: [k, m+k]
                            {
                                bool good = true;
                                if (!checkPlace(l, k) || !checkPlace(l + 1, m + k))
                                    good = false;

                                if (good && plen > 0 && l == plen) {
                                    if (abs(leftBound - k) < m) good = false;
                                }
                                if (good && slen > 0 && l + 1 == N - slen - 1) {
                                    if (abs((m + k) - rightBound) < m) good = false;
                                }

                                if (good) {
                                    ndp[c + 1] += cur;
                                    if (ndp[c + 1] >= MOD) ndp[c + 1] -= MOD;
                                }
                            }

                            // put k on the right: [m+k, k]
                            {
                                bool good = true;
                                if (!checkPlace(r - 1, m + k) || !checkPlace(r, k))
                                    good = false;

                                if (good && plen > 0 && r - 1 == plen) {
                                    if (abs(leftBound - (m + k)) < m) good = false;
                                }
                                if (good && slen > 0 && r == N - slen - 1) {
                                    if (abs(k - rightBound) < m) good = false;
                                }

                                if (good) {
                                    ndp[c] += cur;
                                    if (ndp[c] >= MOD) ndp[c] -= MOD;
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        dp.swap(ndp);
                    }

                    for (int c = 0; c <= m - 1; ++c) {
                        typeB += dp[c];
                        typeB %= MOD;
                    }
                }
            } while (next_permutation(perm.begin(), perm.end()));
        }

        answer = (typeA + typeB) % MOD;
        cout << answer << '\n';
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

static const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;

long long modpow(long long a, long long e) {
    long long r = 1;
    while (e) {
        if (e & 1) r = r * a % MOD;
        a = a * a % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return r;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int T, N;
    cin >> T >> N;

    vector<vector<pair<int,int>>> tests(T);
    for (int t = 0; t < T; ++t) {
        int K;
        cin >> K;
        tests[t].resize(K);
        for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
            cin >> tests[t][i].first >> tests[t][i].second;
        }
    }

    // For small N we can brute-force all permutations.
    if (N <= 20) {
        vector<int> p(N);
        iota(p.begin(), p.end(), 0);
        int m = N / 2;
        vector<vector<int>> good;
        do {
            int best = INT_MAX;
            for (int i = 0; i + 1 < N; ++i)
                best = min(best, abs(p[i] - p[i+1]));
            if (best == m) {
                good.push_back(p);
            }
        } while (next_permutation(p.begin(), p.end()));

        for (auto &cons : tests) {
            long long ans = 0;
            for (auto &q : good) {
                bool ok = true;
                for (auto [pos, val] : cons) {
                    if (q[pos] != val) {
                        ok = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (ok) ++ans;
            }
            cout << ans % MOD << '\n';
        }
        return 0;
    }

    // Large N.
    long long ansNoConstraints;
    if (N % 2 == 0) {
        ansNoConstraints = 2;
    } else {
        long long q = (N - 1) / 2;
        ansNoConstraints = (q + 5) % MOD * modpow(2, q - 1) % MOD;
    }

    for (auto &cons : tests) {
        if (cons.empty()) {
            cout << ansNoConstraints << '\n';
        } else {
            // The full solution for arbitrary constraints is not implemented here.
            // As a fallback, output 0 for constrained large cases.
            cout << 0 << '\n';
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

static const int MOD = 1'000'000'007;
static const int MAXN = 2005;

int fact[MAXN], invFact[MAXN], pow2[MAXN];

int modPow(int a, int e) {
    int r = 1;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) r = (long long)r * a % MOD;
        a = (long long)a * a % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return r;
}

int binom(int n, int k) {
    if (k < 0 || k > n) return 0;
    return (long long)fact[n] * invFact[k] % MOD * invFact[n - k] % MOD;
}

void initComb() {
    fact[0] = 1;
    pow2[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; ++i) {
        fact[i] = (long long)fact[i - 1] * i % MOD;
        pow2[i] = (long long)pow2[i - 1] * 2 % MOD;
    }
    invFact[MAXN - 1] = modPow(fact[MAXN - 1], MOD - 2);
    for (int i = MAXN - 1; i >= 1; --i) {
        invFact[i - 1] = (long long)invFact[i] * i % MOD;
    }
}

struct Candidate {
    int requiredPrefix;
    int incrementsPrefix;
};

struct Item {
    int index;
    Candidate cand[2];
    int cnt = 0;
};

struct State {
    int lastIndex;
    int prefix;
    int ways;
};

void addCandidate(Item &item, int requiredPrefix, int incrementsPrefix,
                  int predictedLow, int predictedHigh,
                  int constrainedLow, int constrainedHigh, int n) {
    if (item.cnt >= 2) return;
    if (requiredPrefix < 0 || requiredPrefix > item.index) return;
    if (predictedLow < 0 || predictedLow >= n) return;
    if (predictedHigh < 0 || predictedHigh >= n) return;

    if (constrainedLow != -1 && constrainedLow != predictedLow) return;
    if (constrainedHigh != -1 && constrainedHigh != predictedHigh) return;

    for (int i = 0; i < item.cnt; ++i) {
        if (item.cand[i].requiredPrefix == requiredPrefix &&
            item.cand[i].incrementsPrefix == incrementsPrefix) {
            return;
        }
    }
    item.cand[item.cnt++] = {requiredPrefix, incrementsPrefix};
}

/*
Count binary strings on 'total' positions.

For each constrained item, its candidates specify:
  - the number of 1's before that item,
  - whether that item is a 1.

Between constrained items, arbitrary positions are counted using binomials.
*/
int countBinary(const vector<Item> &items, int total, int requiredTotal) {
    vector<State> states;
    states.reserve(8);
    states.push_back({-1, 0, 1});

    for (const Item &item : items) {
        vector<State> next;
        next.reserve(8);

        for (const State &st : states) {
            int gap = item.index - st.lastIndex - 1;

            for (int c = 0; c < item.cnt; ++c) {
                int need = item.cand[c].requiredPrefix - st.prefix;
                if (need < 0 || need > gap) continue;

                int ways = (long long)st.ways * binom(gap, need) % MOD;
                int after = item.cand[c].requiredPrefix +
                            item.cand[c].incrementsPrefix;

                bool found = false;
                for (State &ns : next) {
                    if (ns.lastIndex == item.index && ns.prefix == after) {
                        ns.ways += ways;
                        if (ns.ways >= MOD) ns.ways -= MOD;
                        found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!found) next.push_back({item.index, after, ways});
            }
        }

        states.swap(next);
        if (states.empty()) return 0;
    }

    int result = 0;
    int remaining = total - states.back().lastIndex - 1;

    if (requiredTotal == -1) {
        for (const State &st : states) {
            result = (result + (long long)st.ways * pow2[remaining]) % MOD;
        }
    } else {
        for (const State &st : states) {
            int need = requiredTotal - st.prefix;
            if (need < 0 || need > remaining) continue;
            int ways = (long long)st.ways * binom(remaining, need) % MOD;
            result += ways;
            if (result >= MOD) result -= MOD;
        }
    }
    return result;
}

bool matches(const vector<int> &pos, int value, int expected) {
    return pos[value] == -1 || pos[value] == expected;
}

/*
Strict paths: the special edge L0-Lm is not used.

Choose a set X of labels inserted on the left:
  X in decreasing order: Lq,Hq
  L0
  complement in increasing order: Hq,Lq

x is the size of X.
*/
int countStrict(const vector<int> &pos, int m) {
    int n = 2 * m + 1;
    int answer = 0;

    for (int x = 0; x <= m; ++x) {
        if (!matches(pos, 0, 2 * x)) continue;

        vector<Item> items;
        items.reserve(m);

        for (int q = 1; q <= m; ++q) {
            int lowPos = pos[q];
            int highPos = pos[m + q];
            if (lowPos == -1 && highPos == -1) continue;

            Item item;
            item.index = q - 1;

            // q is in X (left side).
            {
                int req = -1;
                if (lowPos != -1) {
                    if (lowPos % 2 == 0) req = x - 1 - lowPos / 2;
                } else {
                    int low = highPos - 1;
                    if (low >= 0 && low % 2 == 0) {
                        req = x - 1 - low / 2;
                    }
                }

                if (req >= 0 && req <= q - 1 && req <= x - 1) {
                    int pl = 2 * (x - req - 1);
                    int ph = pl + 1;
                    addCandidate(item, req, 1, pl, ph,
                                 lowPos, highPos, n);
                }
            }

            // q is not in X (right side).
            {
                int req = -1;
                if (lowPos != -1) {
                    int difference = lowPos - 2 * x;
                    if (difference >= 0 && difference % 2 == 0) {
                        req = q - 1 - difference / 2;
                    }
                } else {
                    int difference = highPos - (2 * x + 1);
                    if (difference >= 0 && difference % 2 == 0) {
                        req = q - 1 - difference / 2;
                    }
                }

                if (req >= 0 && req <= q - 1) {
                    int lowerB = q - 1 - req;
                    int totalB = m - x;
                    if (lowerB >= 0 && lowerB < totalB) {
                        int ph = 2 * x + 1 + 2 * lowerB;
                        int pl = ph + 1;
                        addCandidate(item, req, 0, pl, ph,
                                     lowPos, highPos, n);
                    }
                }
            }

            if (item.cnt) items.push_back(item);
        }

        answer += countBinary(items, m, x);
        if (answer >= MOD) answer -= MOD;
    }

    return answer;
}

/*
Used paths with every Hq-Lq pair adjacent.

Choose X subset of {1,...,m-1}:
  X decreasing: Lq,Hq
  L0,Lm,Hm
  complement decreasing: Lq,Hq
*/
int countUsedType0(const vector<int> &pos, int m) {
    int n = 2 * m + 1;
    int answer = 0;

    for (int x = 0; x <= m - 1; ++x) {
        if (!matches(pos, 0, 2 * x)) continue;
        if (!matches(pos, m, 2 * x + 1)) continue;
        if (!matches(pos, 2 * m, 2 * x + 2)) continue;

        vector<Item> items;
        items.reserve(m);

        for (int q = m - 1; q >= 1; --q) {
            int lowPos = pos[q];
            int highPos = pos[m + q];
            if (lowPos == -1 && highPos == -1) continue;

            Item item;
            item.index = m - 1 - q;

            // q belongs to X.
            {
                int req = -1;
                if (lowPos != -1) {
                    if (lowPos % 2 == 0) req = lowPos / 2;
                } else {
                    if (highPos % 2 == 1) req = (highPos - 1) / 2;
                }

                if (req >= 0 && req <= item.index && req <= x - 1) {
                    int pl = 2 * req;
                    int ph = pl + 1;
                    addCandidate(item, req, 1, pl, ph,
                                 lowPos, highPos, n);
                }
            }

            // q belongs to the complement.
            {
                int req = -1;
                int higherComplement = -1;
                int higherCount = m - 1 - q;
                int totalComplement = m - 1 - x;

                if (lowPos != -1) {
                    int difference = lowPos - (2 * x + 3);
                    if (difference >= 0 && difference % 2 == 0) {
                        higherComplement = difference / 2;
                    }
                } else {
                    int low = highPos - 1;
                    int difference = low - (2 * x + 3);
                    if (difference >= 0 && difference % 2 == 0) {
                        higherComplement = difference / 2;
                    }
                }

                if (higherComplement >= 0 &&
                    higherComplement < totalComplement) {
                    req = higherCount - higherComplement;
                    int pl = 2 * x + 3 + 2 * higherComplement;
                    int ph = pl + 1;
                    addCandidate(item, req, 0, pl, ph,
                                 lowPos, highPos, n);
                }
            }

            if (item.cnt) items.push_back(item);
        }

        answer += countBinary(items, m - 1, x);
        if (answer >= MOD) answer -= MOD;
    }

    return answer;
}

/*
Upper part of a defective used path, d < m.

The position of L0 is P = 2m-2d+1, independent of the choices.
*/
int countDefectUpper(const vector<int> &pos, int m, int d) {
    int n = 2 * m + 1;
    int P = 2 * m - 2 * d + 1;

    if (!matches(pos, 0, P)) return 0;
    if (!matches(pos, m, P - 1)) return 0;
    if (!matches(pos, 2 * m, P - 2)) return 0;

    int requiredTotal = -1;
    if (pos[d] != -1) {
        if (pos[d] % 2) return 0;
        requiredTotal = pos[d] / 2;
        if (requiredTotal > m - d - 1) return 0;
    }

    vector<Item> items;
    items.reserve(m);

    for (int q = m - 1; q >= d + 1; --q) {
        int lowPos = pos[q];
        int highPos = pos[m + q];
        if (lowPos == -1 && highPos == -1) continue;

        Item item;
        item.index = m - 1 - q;

        // q is in the decreasing first upper list.
        {
            int req = -1;
            if (lowPos != -1) {
                if (lowPos % 2 == 0) req = lowPos / 2;
            } else {
                if (highPos % 2 == 1) req = (highPos - 1) / 2;
            }

            if (req >= 0 && req <= item.index) {
                int pl = 2 * req;
                int ph = pl + 1;
                addCandidate(item, req, 1, pl, ph,
                             lowPos, highPos, n);
            }
        }

        // q is in the increasing second upper list.
        {
            int req = -1;
            int high = -1;
            if (lowPos != -1) high = lowPos - 1;
            else high = highPos;

            int difference = P - high;
            if (high >= 0 && difference >= 0 && difference % 2 == 0) {
                req = m + 1 - q - difference / 2;
                if (req >= 0 && req <= item.index) {
                    int ph = P - 2 * (m + 1 - q - req);
                    int pl = ph + 1;
                    addCandidate(item, req, 0, pl, ph,
                                 lowPos, highPos, n);
                }
            }
        }

        if (item.cnt) items.push_back(item);
    }

    return countBinary(items, m - d - 1, requiredTotal);
}

/*
Lower part of a defective used path.

For d=m this is the whole variable part.
*/
int countDefectLower(const vector<int> &pos, int m, int d) {
    int n = 2 * m + 1;
    int P = (d == m ? 1 : 2 * m - 2 * d + 1);

    if (d == m) {
        if (!matches(pos, m, 0)) return 0;
        if (!matches(pos, 0, 1)) return 0;
    } else {
        if (!matches(pos, 0, P)) return 0;
    }

    int defectiveHigh = m + d;
    int requiredTotal = -1;
    if (pos[defectiveHigh] != -1) {
        int difference = pos[defectiveHigh] - (P + 1);
        if (difference < 0 || difference % 2) return 0;
        requiredTotal = difference / 2;
        if (requiredTotal > d - 1) return 0;
    }

    vector<Item> items;
    items.reserve(d);

    for (int q = 1; q <= d - 1; ++q) {
        int lowPos = pos[q];
        int highPos = pos[m + q];
        if (lowPos == -1 && highPos == -1) continue;

        Item item;
        item.index = q - 1;

        // q is in the increasing first lower list.
        {
            int req = -1;
            int high = -1;
            if (lowPos != -1) high = lowPos - 1;
            else high = highPos;

            int difference = high - (P + 1);
            if (high >= 0 && difference >= 0 && difference % 2 == 0) {
                req = difference / 2;
                if (req >= 0 && req <= item.index) {
                    int ph = P + 1 + 2 * req;
                    int pl = ph + 1;
                    addCandidate(item, req, 1, pl, ph,
                                 lowPos, highPos, n);
                }
            }
        }

        // q is in the decreasing second lower list.
        {
            int req = -1;
            int low = -1;
            if (lowPos != -1) low = lowPos;
            else low = highPos - 1;

            int difference = n - low;
            if (low >= 0 && difference >= 0 && difference % 2 == 0) {
                req = q - difference / 2;
                if (req >= 0 && req <= item.index) {
                    int pl = n - 2 * (q - req);
                    int ph = pl + 1;
                    addCandidate(item, req, 0, pl, ph,
                                 lowPos, highPos, n);
                }
            }
        }

        if (item.cnt) items.push_back(item);
    }

    return countBinary(items, d - 1, requiredTotal);
}

/*
Count used paths oriented from their low endpoint to their high endpoint.
*/
int countUsedForward(const vector<int> &pos, int m) {
    int answer = countUsedType0(pos, m);

    for (int d = 1; d <= m; ++d) {
        if (d < m) {
            int upper = countDefectUpper(pos, m, d);
            if (upper == 0) continue;
            int lower = countDefectLower(pos, m, d);
            answer = (answer + (long long)upper * lower) % MOD;
        } else {
            answer += countDefectLower(pos, m, d);
            if (answer >= MOD) answer -= MOD;
        }
    }

    return answer;
}

int solveSmallCompletion(const vector<int> &pos, int n, int m,
                         const vector<int> &missingValues,
                         const vector<int> &missingPositions) {
    vector<int> p(n, -1);
    for (int v = 0; v < n; ++v) {
        if (pos[v] != -1) p[pos[v]] = v;
    }

    vector<int> values = missingValues;
    sort(values.begin(), values.end());

    int answer = 0;
    do {
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)missingPositions.size(); ++i) {
            p[missingPositions[i]] = values[i];
        }

        bool good = true;
        for (int i = 0; i + 1 < n; ++i) {
            if (abs(p[i] - p[i + 1]) < m) {
                good = false;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (good) {
            ++answer;
            if (answer == MOD) answer = 0;
        }
    } while (next_permutation(values.begin(), values.end()));

    return answer;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    initComb();

    int T, N;
    cin >> T >> N;

    int m = N / 2;

    while (T--) {
        int K;
        cin >> K;

        vector<int> pos(N, -1);
        vector<bool> usedPosition(N, false), usedValue(N, false);

        for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
            int index, value;
            cin >> index >> value;
            pos[value] = index;
            usedPosition[index] = true;
            usedValue[value] = true;
        }

        // Fast path: only a few values/positions are unspecified.
        int missingCount = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            missingCount += !usedPosition[i];
        }
        if (missingCount <= 6) {
            vector<int> missingValues, missingPositions;
            for (int v = 0; v < N; ++v) {
                if (!usedValue[v]) missingValues.push_back(v);
            }
            for (int p = 0; p < N; ++p) {
                if (!usedPosition[p]) missingPositions.push_back(p);
            }
            cout << solveSmallCompletion(pos, N, m, missingValues,
                                        missingPositions)
                 << '\n';
            continue;
        }

        if (K == 0) {
            if (N % 2 == 0) {
                cout << 2 << '\n';
            } else {
                int answer = (long long)(m + 5) * pow2[m - 1] % MOD;
                cout << answer << '\n';
            }
            continue;
        }

        if (N % 2 == 0) {
            vector<int> p1, p2;
            for (int q = 0; q < m; ++q) {
                p1.push_back(m - 1 - q);
                p1.push_back(2 * m - 1 - q);
            }
            p2.assign(p1.rbegin(), p1.rend());

            int answer = 0;
            for (const auto &p : {p1, p2}) {
                bool good = true;
                for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
                    if (pos[p[i]] != -1 && pos[p[i]] != i) {
                        good = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (good) {
                    ++answer;
                    if (answer == MOD) answer = 0;
                }
            }
            cout << answer << '\n';
            continue;
        }

        int strict = countStrict(pos, m);

        int usedForward = countUsedForward(pos, m);

        vector<int> reversedPos(N, -1);
        for (int v = 0; v < N; ++v) {
            if (pos[v] != -1) reversedPos[v] = N - 1 - pos[v];
        }
        int usedReverse = countUsedForward(reversedPos, m);

        int answer = strict;
        answer += usedForward;
        if (answer >= MOD) answer -= MOD;
        answer += usedReverse;
        if (answer >= MOD) answer -= MOD;

        cout << answer << '\n';
    }

    return 0;
}
